modifications: All source countries, states and city/place records retained; no population or place-type filtering.
Country/state display names use existing zh-CN translation, with source native/name fallback.
City aliases retain source native, English, simplified/traditional Chinese and existing romanized/alias fields; other translations remain in work source files.
Numeric source IDs preserved. Source records without IDs get explicit deterministic csc-pending identifiers.
Coordinates converted from source decimal strings to JSON numbers; no coordinate rounding.
Grouped as classic JavaScript chunks for static and file:// loading.
pendingIdAlgorithm: csc-pending-ISO2- + first 24 hex of SHA256(UTF8 compact JSON [ISO2,state_id,name,sourceLatitudeString,sourceLongitudeString]); source name trimmed, no generated place names.
coverageNote: Community-maintained snapshot; city table also includes towns, districts, administrative units and historical entries. Not a claim of absolute worldwide completeness.
